docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that produce wrong version format, extra/missing
lines, wrong project name, or wrong version number — must be exactly
'RustOwl v1.0.0-rc.1\n' with nothing else.

CATCHES: implementations that don't generate Lifetime decorations showing
variable live ranges, fail to track when variables must remain valid, omit
lifetime annotations in scope analysis, or incorrectly compute variable drop
points.
Each main subcommand should respond to --help.

CATCHES: implementations that accept check-specific flags like --all-targets
on completions command, or silently ignore command-specific flags on wrong commands.

CATCHES: implementations where -V and --version produce different output format,
different capitalization, or inconsistent whitespace.

CATCHES: implementations that modify, omit, or corrupt any part of the
default configuration reference — including the ASCII art header, comment
formatting, TOML structure, default values, or trailing whitespace. The
output must match byte-for-byte.

Golden files: default_config.golden -- ./executable --config-reference

CATCHES: implementations that truncate stdin after a certain number of lines,
fail to write all stdin lines through write_stdin_to_child, or have buffer
size limits that cause data loss. The command 'seq 1 1000 | tail -5' must
receive all 1000 lines via stdin and correctly output the last 5.

Golden files:
    large_stdin_to_tail.golden -- screen showing lines 996-1000

CATCHES: implementations that crash or display incorrectly when opening
the bookmarks list with no entries.

Golden files (eval/test_resources/test_command_list_window/):
    bookmarks_empty.golden -- empty bookmarks list display
Test reading from symlink.

CATCHES: implementations that don't support Ctrl+P (previous) and Ctrl+N (next)
for history navigation, fail to cycle through history correctly, or lose cursor
position when navigating through multiline history entries.

docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that open editor but don't save changes, ignore editor
modifications, or commit without including user's edits from the editor session.

CATCHES: implementations that accept empty idea summaries, that commit
with blank messages, or that don't re-prompt when input is empty. The
binary should keep prompting until a non-empty idea is provided.

Golden files: (none - all assertions are inline structural checks)
Test that special characters in idea summary are handled.
Test -h flag shows usage information.
Test -h flag outputs correct help text.

CATCHES: implementations that omit section wrappers for empty sections (sections
with only a heading and no content), or implementations that generate malformed
HTML when a section contains only empty subsections, or implementations that fail
to properly close empty section tags.

CATCHES: implementations that fail on mismatched open/close tags (e.g., opening
but closing ), either refusing to parse, crashing, or producing malformed output instead of recovering and continuing parsing.

CATCHES: implementations that incorrectly convert djot to html
Test from 5793.md, case 2
Command: pandoc -f djot -t html

CATCHES: implementations that don't respect split-level parameter or produce
wrong split granularity — split-level=2 should create separate HTML files for
level-2 headings in addition to level-1.
CATCHES: implementations that fail to convert from latex to markdown for test 987
Test Ctrl+U moves backward half page after Ctrl+D.

CATCHES: implementations that don't support --follow-name flag, fail to monitor
files by name (allowing file rotation), or crash when follow-name mode is enabled —
verified by starting follow-name mode on a file and checking that the process starts
and runs successfully.
Test navigation to end with End key.

CATCHES: implementations that crash on empty stdin with memory limits, hang
waiting for stdin input when none is provided, produce error messages for empty
stdin with chunking, or fail to recognize EOF on first stdin read with memory constraints.
Test TUI decompresses .xz file.
Test --column-width without two arguments
Test special characters in directory and file names.
CATCHES: implementations that count hardlinked files multiple times instead of deduplicating with --deduplicate-hardlinks.

CATCHES: implementations where --progress with --deduplicate-hardlinks
causes incorrect progress counts, crashes, or produces wrong totals.
CATCHES: implementations that deduplicate across multiple path arguments even without the flag.

CATCHES: implementations that fail basic QUIC handshake, can't establish a 
bidirectional connection, don't complete data transfer, or crash during transfer.
The normalized golden output verifies connection stats structure, RPS metrics, stream
metrics (upload/download duration, throughput, FBL), and percentile calculations.

Golden files: basic_connection.golden -- ./executable client --duration 2 127.0.0.1:PORT (normalized)
Client should apply bbr congestion algorithm and attempt connection.
Test server with different transport configurations.
Client should accept new-reno congestion algorithm and show connection attempt.
Client with invalid stream-receive-window should show parse error.

CATCHES: implementations that don't serialize priority in Query.String(),
breaking context display when priority filters are active.

Tests query.go:70-71 - Priority serialization
CATCHES: implementations that don't filter tasks by 'due.on:' operator

CATCHES: implementations that accept invalid date filter modifiers like
'due.badfilter:2024-01-01' instead of rejecting with proper error message.
Valid filters are: after, before, on, in.

Tests ParseDueDateArg error path at lines 86-89 for invalid date filter.
Test showing current context.
Test adding many tasks in sequence.
